text:
Type: terracotta plant pot with saucer
Use: growing herbs or houseplants on a windowsill, a shelf or a table; living room, kitchen, sunroom
Style: rustic, farmhouse, bohemian
Materials: unglazed terracotta clay, matching deep saucer
Colors: warm terracotta orange
Shape: classic tapered round pot with a thick rolled rim, sitting in a wide deep saucer, sturdy and compact
Feel: earthy, warm, natural, homey
Goes with: green plants, herbs, white walls, rattan, light wood; rustic, Mediterranean or bohemian rooms

product.name: INGEFRA
product.description: The porous terracotta holds excess water, so the plant can draw out moisture when needed.
